column2: Wide establishing shot at dawn: a small Vietnamese alley made of clay, a row of pastel clay shophouses with balconies and potted plants, one small cosy house with sage-green shutters and a sage door in the centre, soft morning mist, a few clay birds on a wire, warm sunrise glow. Hun is NOT in this shot.
column3: Morning light slowly spreads across the alley; a thin wisp of kitchen smoke rises from a chimney; two clay birds flap and shift on the wire; mist drifts.

column2: Close shot of the sage-green clay front door opening; Hun peeks out from behind the door with a curious face (expression sheet: curious), only head, one flipper and part of the body visible. Warm low sunlight.
column3: The door opens a little wider each frame; Hun leans out more, tilts head, blinks once around frame 5, ends with a small smile.

column2: Medium shot: Hun stands on the doorstep holding a small clay broom, a neat little pile of clay leaves beside, waving one flipper at the camera, happy. Potted clay plants, open sage doors, scooter and pastel street behind.
column3: Hun sweeps the last leaf onto the pile (frames 1-3), then lifts the free flipper and waves (frames 4-8), tuft bouncing slightly.

column2: Medium-wide: inside by a window at sunrise, Hun pushes open the sage clay shutters and stretches both flippers up, eyes closed, content. Pink-blue sunrise over clay rooftops outside.
column3: Shutters swing open a bit more each frame; Hun stretches higher, rises slightly on tiptoe, then settles with a happy sigh.

column2: Close-up on a clay window sill: a neat row of 7 small round clay mood faces from sad (blue-grey) to happy (pink), Hun's flipper hovering above them deciding, Hun's thinking face in the soft-focus background (expression: curious).
column3: Hun's flipper glides slowly along the row from left to right, pausing over each face, finally lands and picks up the 6th face (happy).

column2: Close-up: Hun hugs a small happy clay mood face against the heart on its belly, eyes closed, peaceful smile (expression: proud). A small open clay diary with a little heart beside. Warm morning light, steam from a tea cup.
column3: Hun squeezes the face gently closer, sways slightly side to side, cheeks blush deeper, steam curls.

column2: Medium shot in a bright noon clay kitchen with striped shutter shadows: a small clay smartphone on the counter lights up with a glowing bell icon and a pill icon (icons only, no text), Hun turns toward it with a surprised face (expression: surprised).
column3: The phone glows and wobbles as if vibrating; Hun turns from side view to facing the phone, eyes widen, beak opens slightly.

column2: Close-up: Hun carefully drops one tiny clay pill into a colourful 7-compartment clay weekly pill organizer, focused, tongue slightly out. Clay blood pressure monitor and glass of water nearby. Striped noon light.
column3: The pill moves from the flipper down into the compartment across frames; the lid of that compartment closes in the last frames; Hun smiles.

column2: Medium close-up: Hun wraps a tiny clay blood-pressure cuff around its own flipper; the clay monitor screen shows a little green clay heart (no numbers, no text); Hun looks proud (expression: proud). Framed clay picture of a countryside house on the wall.
column3: The cuff puffs up then deflates; the green heart on the monitor appears and pulses; Hun's smile widens and closes eyes happily.

column2: Medium-wide at sunset: Hun walks into the clay kitchen carrying a small woven clay market basket full of clay vegetables and a bánh mì, about to set it on the round clay table. Warm sunset rim light, violet shadows, hanging lamp.
column3: Hun takes small waddling steps toward the table and lifts the basket onto it; vegetables jiggle; lamp glow flickers slightly.

column2: Close-up: Hun holds a small clay smartphone; on its screen two soft speech-bubble shapes (no letters, just bubble shapes and a tiny coin icon); Hun taps the screen with a flipper, curious face (expression: curious). Warm evening light.
column3: The bubble shapes slide up and a coin icon pops out; Hun taps, leans closer, then nods.

column2: Medium close-up: Hun stands on the round clay table pushing a big golden clay coin into the slot of a round terracotta clay coin jar decorated with a lotus relief, proud smile. Clay notebook and cà phê sữa đá nearby. Sunset rim light.
column3: The coin slides into the slot across frames; the jar squashes slightly and settles; Hun closes eyes in a proud smile and does a tiny bounce.

column2: Medium-wide Sunday afternoon: Hun pours tea from a clay teapot into four different clay cups set around a low round family table, plate of clay fruit, clay lunar tear-off calendar and small altar shelf with flowers on the wall. Warm honey light.
column3: Tea stream flows; each cup fills a little in turn; Hun moves from cup to cup.

column2: Medium shot: Hun stands on the low table next to a small bar chart made of stacked pastel clay blocks (7 bars), pointing happily at the bars, the last bar lower than the others. Warm afternoon light.
column3: Hun places the last block on a bar, then steps back and points, bouncing happily.

column2: Medium close-up: Hun holds out toward the camera a heart-shaped clay invitation card covered with a small square grid pattern like a QR code (no letters), cheerful inviting face (expression: happy). Soft warm afternoon, cups and teapot blurred behind.
column3: Hun brings the card closer to the camera, tilts it, winks on frame 6, card wobbles.

column2: Medium shot at night: Hun sits on a bed with a patchwork clay quilt under a warm bedside lamp, writing in a small clay diary with a clay pencil, calm. Cool blue moonlight through the window, clay stars.
column3: The pencil moves along the page; Hun pauses, looks up thinking, then writes again.

column2: Close-up of the small clay diary closing and a little heart-shaped clay padlock clicking shut, held by Hun's flippers; lamp glow.
column3: The diary closes over the frames; the padlock shackle snaps down; a tiny sparkle on the lock in the final frame.

column2: Medium shot: Hun on the bed, yawning, eyes closing, head nodding down into sleep; the bedside lamp dims; moon and clay stars outside.
column3: Yawn opens then closes; eyes go half then fully shut; head nods; lamp light gets dimmer each frame; a small clay 'z' shape is NOT used, no text.

column2: A tiny clay cinema ticket booth on a Vietnamese street corner, sage-green clay awning with a row of glowing warm bulbs, terracotta flower pots. Hun stands behind the counter happily holding out one big pink clay ticket toward the camera, stack of cream tickets beside. No readable text anywhere.
column3: The bulbs twinkle alternately; Hun pushes the ticket forward a little and back, smiling.

column2: Blue dusk: Hun sits on the front step of the clay house next to a sage-green clay mailbox, reading a small cream clay letter, curious and attentive; little pile of letters and envelopes beside; string of warm fairy lights. No readable text.
column3: Hun lowers the letter, looks up thinking, then raises it again; fairy lights twinkle.

column2: Final shot: a small clay theatre stage with heavy sage-green clay curtains, warm spotlight circle; Hun stands in the spotlight taking a polite bow, pink clay rose petals on the floor. No text.
column3: Hun bows down and up; the curtains slowly close from both sides across the frames; a petal falls.
